payload.summary: Sixth distinct load-flake: intervene handback test hits bun's 5s per-test timeout under full-suite load (2 of 8 runs), then afterEach removes the temp dir under the still-running git call and the NEXT test cascades — that cascade pattern (cleanup racing a timed-out test's still-live child process) is a sharper diagnosis than the earlier notes had; passes 3/3 isolated. Suite now 2044 tests.
